coleccionista.hola: The Collector's Games is running with %s
coleccionista.chat.eliminado: has been eliminated and is now part of the collection.
coleccionista.chat.ganador: %s is the last piece. My collection is complete... for now.
coleccionista.chat.equipos: The teams are set. You didn't choose your teammates... and they didn't choose you.
coleccionista.chat.parejas: The pairs are set. Trust yours... if you can.
coleccionista.fantasma.eres: You are a ghost now: you see everything, but the living can't see or hear you.
coleccionista.fantasma.no_hablar: Ghosts can't talk to the living.
coleccionista.escena.mi_titulo: YOU HAVE BEEN ADDED TO THE COLLECTION
coleccionista.escena.mi_sub: You are a ghost now. Watch, but you can't help anyone.
coleccionista.cmd.quitado: %s is no longer in the event.
coleccionista.cmd.organizador: Done: they are organizers (they don't play).
coleccionista.cmd.pocos: At least 2 living pieces are needed.
coleccionista.cmd.reiniciar_confirmar: This erases the whole event. If you're sure: /evento reiniciar confirmar
coleccionista.cmd.reiniciado: The event was erased: everyone is back to normal.
coleccionista.panel.inscribir_todos_ayud: Adds everyone online who isn't an organizer.
coleccionista.panel.yo_organizador_ayuda: Removes you from the pieces and makes you an organizer (you don't play).
coleccionista.panel.eliminar_ayuda: Sends them to the collection: chat announcement, scene, and they become a ghost.
coleccionista.panel.revivir_ayuda: In case of a mistake: back in the game where they are.
coleccionista.panel.seguir_ayuda: The camera follows this piece. Move to release it.
coleccionista.panel.quitar_ayuda: Removes them completely (doesn't count as eliminated).
coleccionista.panel.elige: Pick a piece from the list.
coleccionista.panel.vacio: Nobody yet. Use "Sign up everyone" or /evento bots 8 to test.
coleccionista.panel.anunciar_ayuda: Type something and it shows in chat as if the Collector said it.
coleccionista.panel.reiniciar_ayuda: Erases the whole event. Press it twice.
coleccionista.panel.guardar_toma_ayuda: Saves where you are and where you look as a camera shot.
coleccionista.panel.viajar_ayuda: The camera glides to the chosen shot.
coleccionista.panel.recorrido_ayuda: Glides through every shot in order (great to present a trial).
coleccionista.panel.espectador_ayuda: So the camera can fly and go through walls.
coleccionista.panel.camara_nota: Move (W A S D) to release the camera. F1 hides everything from Minecraft. K key: event HUD.
coleccionista.panel.sin_tomas: No shots. Go where you want to record and press "Save here".
coleccionista.panel.tomas_llenas: There are already %s shots: delete one.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.no_sabes: I know you don't know who you are… or what you're doing here.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.piezas: Each of you is a piece. Unique. Fragile. Mine.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.una_sale: Tonight we will play several games… and only one piece will leave this place.
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.listo: But tell me… are you ready to play a game?
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.risa: Heh, heh, heh… Ha, ha, ha, ha!
coleccionista.voz.bienvenida.candado: Your cell has a lock. The code is closer than you think. Let the collection begin.
coleccionista.chat.candados: The locks work now. Find the three numbers… or stay here forever.
coleccionista.pista.nota1: The first number is %s. The other two are scratched on the walls.
coleccionista.diario.1: Day 3. I can't hear the piece next door anymore. Yesterday they screamed. Today there's only silence… and a new portrait in the hall.
coleccionista.diario.2: Don't trust your partner. I did. Now I'm writing this from… I don't know where.
coleccionista.diario.3: The Collector never lies. That's the worst part.
coleccionista.diario.4: If you find this: the numbers are always in the first thing you look at when you wake up.
coleccionista.diario.5: I counted the cells: twenty-four. I counted the beds: twenty-four. I counted the exits: one.
coleccionista.diario.6: His laugh gets stuck in your head. He laughs when someone fails.
coleccionista.diario.7: Don't sleep. When you sleep, he moves things around.
coleccionista.diario.8: The mask is cracked on one side. Up close, I'd swear something moves behind the crack.
coleccionista.candado.ayuda: Arrows or type the numbers · Enter
coleccionista.candado.muerto: The lock has no light… yet.
coleccionista.espera.nota: Don't disconnect: when everyone is ready, it will begin.
coleccionista.cmd.sin_mapa: Build the map first: /evento construir (stand where the west corner goes).
coleccionista.cmd.sala: Waiting room ready: everyone in their cell, in bed, in the dark.
coleccionista.cmd.solo_overworld: The map goes in the overworld.
coleccionista.panel.g_sala_ayuda: Everyone to their cell, in bed, in the dark, unable to touch anything.
coleccionista.panel.g_despertar_ayuda: Lights on and everyone wakes up with their cinematic (then 10 minutes to investigate).
coleccionista.panel.g_discurso_ayuda: Screens turn on and the Collector speaks now (without waiting for the clock).
coleccionista.panel.g_abrir_ayuda: Opens every door even without the code.
coleccionista.panel.g_disfraz_ayuda: Put on (or take off) the Collector's costume to appear in front of everyone.
coleccionista.enc.sin_mapa: The Sewers aren't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.enc.ya_empezo: Chained is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.enc.pocos: At least 2 living pieces are needed.
coleccionista.enc.fundido: You wake up with something cold and heavy around your ankle…
coleccionista.enc.lema: What binds you… also saves you
coleccionista.enc.chat.empieza: The gate is open. The Shelter only has room for %s of %s pairs. The gas comes out in %s seconds.
coleccionista.enc.llave_vieja: This key doesn't open anything anymore.
coleccionista.enc.ya_libre: You're no longer chained to the wall.
coleccionista.enc.llave_ajena: This key belongs to Piece %s: throw it to them with Q.
coleccionista.enc.libre: The shackle opened! Now get out together.
coleccionista.enc.chat.cierre: There's no more room in the Shelter. The gate closes… and the gas waits for no one.
coleccionista.enc.chat.tiempo: Time's up. The gate closes… and the gas waits for no one.
coleccionista.enc.chat.fin: The trial is over. %s pairs were saved. The rest… are mine now.
coleccionista.enc.cmd.preparada: Chained is ready: everyone to the Shackle Hall (Shelter spots: %s).
coleccionista.enc.cmd.sin_marca: Marker %s doesn't exist (or the Sewers aren't built).
coleccionista.enc.cmd.gracia: The gas will come out %s seconds after the gate opens.
coleccionista.enc.cmd.terminada: Chained ended: no chains, gates open and keys removed.
coleccionista.item.llave_ayuda: Opens a single shackle. If it isn't yours, throw it (Q) and it flies to its owner.
coleccionista.enc.hud.tu_llave: Your key is in Piece %s's barrel: ask for it.
coleccionista.enc.hud.su_llave: Their key is in your barrel: take it out and throw it with Q.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.hola: Good morning, pieces. Did you sleep well?
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.cadena: Each of you is bound to someone. You didn't choose them… I did.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.llaves: Your keys aren't with you. They're in your partner's barrel.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.gas: When the gate opens, gas will start filling the sewers. Don't breathe it for long.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.cupo: At the end of the tunnel there's a shelter. There isn't room for everyone.
coleccionista.voz.encadenados.suerte: What binds you… also saves you. Let the game begin.
coleccionista.panel.enc_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and everyone wakes up chained in the Shackle Hall, in pairs (random pairs if there are none).
coleccionista.panel.enc_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains the trial on the screens; when he finishes, the gate opens.
coleccionista.panel.enc_ya_ayuda: Opens the gate without the speech.
coleccionista.panel.enc_soltar_ayuda: Removes every wall shackle (in case someone gets stuck). The chain between partners stays.
coleccionista.panel.enc_cerrar_ayuda: Closes the exit now: whoever didn't reach the Shelter is eliminated.
coleccionista.panel.enc_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial without eliminating anyone: removes the chains, opens the gates and deletes the keys.
coleccionista.panel.enc_cuenta: Safe: %s of %s spots · pairs: %s · chained to the wall: %s
coleccionista.panel.enc_nota: Each pair wakes up chained to the wall; each one's key is in the other's barrel. Then they cross the Sewers tied together (two-plate gates, three pipes where only one works, a bridge) with the gas behind them. When the Shelter is full, the gate closes.
coleccionista.panel.pruebas_proximas: Coming soon: The Traitor, Blind and The Sacrifice.
coleccionista.panel.enc_estado.lista: Ready: everyone chained, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.enc_estado.cierre: The gate closed: eliminating those outside…
coleccionista.enc.chat.perdon: Nobody made it… How disappointing. The pair that got the furthest stays in my game. For now.
coleccionista.com.sin_mapa: The Table Hall isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.com.ya_empezo: Share or Steal is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.com.fundido: It smells of old wood and candle wax…
coleccionista.com.chat.perdonado: %s, you don't play this time. Consider it… a gift.
coleccionista.com.chat.hablen: You have %s seconds to talk with your partner. Then each of you will choose in secret.
coleccionista.com.chat.perdon: Stealing to the very end? How greedy… I won't run out of pieces today.
coleccionista.com.chat.fin: Every table has been revealed. %s pieces stayed in my collection.
coleccionista.com.cmd.preparada: Share or Steal is ready: everyone to the Hall's tables.
coleccionista.com.cmd.no_lista: Prepare Share or Steal first (/evento compartir preparar).
coleccionista.com.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in Share or Steal.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.hola: Welcome to my hall. Take a seat… or better, stay standing.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.mesa: In front of you is your partner for tonight.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.hablen: You'll have one minute to talk. Promise whatever you like.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.elijan: Then each of you will choose in secret: share… or steal.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.reglas: If both share, both go on. If one steals, only they go on. If both steal… both stay with me.
coleccionista.voz.compartir.confianza: Trust is beautiful. It also comes at a price.
coleccionista.com.reglas: Both share: both go on. One steals: only they go on. Both steal: both stay in the collection. If you don't choose, you share.
coleccionista.com.elegiste_robar: You chose STEAL. Nobody else knows… yet.
coleccionista.com.elegiste_compartir: You chose SHARE. Nobody else knows… yet.
coleccionista.com.hud.perdonado: You don't play this time: the Collector spared you
coleccionista.com.hud.hablen: Talk with %s: then you'll choose in secret
coleccionista.com.res.roban: Both stole: both stay in the collection.
coleccionista.panel.com_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and everyone to a Hall table, in new random pairs (if the count is odd, one is spared).
coleccionista.panel.com_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains the trial, then the minute to talk begins.
coleccionista.panel.com_ya_ayuda: Starts the minute to talk without the speech.
coleccionista.panel.com_elegir_ayuda: Ends the talk: everyone gets the screen to choose in secret.
coleccionista.panel.com_revelar_ayuda: Ends the choosing time (whoever didn't choose, shares) and the tables are revealed one by one.
coleccionista.panel.com_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial (those already eliminated stay eliminated).
coleccionista.panel.com_estado.lista: Ready: everyone at their table, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.pue.sin_mapa: The Door Room isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.pue.ya_empezo: The Doors is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.pue.fundido: A cold draft comes from somewhere below…
coleccionista.pue.lema: Behind one of them there is no floor
coleccionista.pue.pista.1: I wouldn't go through the %s door.
coleccionista.pue.pista.3: Behind the %s door there's no floor… or is there?
coleccionista.pue.pista.4: If I were you, I'd stay away from the %s door.
coleccionista.pue.chat.ronda: Round %s of %s. Choose a door and go in before the gates close. And remember: sometimes I lie.
coleccionista.pue.elegi_por_ti: You didn't choose… so I chose for you.
coleccionista.pue.chat.perdon: Everyone at the same door? How boring… This time the floor holds.
coleccionista.pue.chat.trampa: The trap was behind the %s door. There were %s inside.
coleccionista.pue.chat.fin: The doors are done. %s pieces fell into my collection.
coleccionista.pue.cmd.preparada: The Doors is ready (%s rounds): everyone to the lobby.
coleccionista.pue.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in The Doors.
coleccionista.pue.hud.elige: Round %s of %s · get into a booth before the gates close
coleccionista.panel.pue_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and everyone to the Door Room lobby.
coleccionista.panel.pue_ronda_ayuda: New colors, the Collector's hint and the gates open to choose.
coleccionista.panel.pue_cerrar_ayuda: Ends the choosing time: whoever didn't choose goes into a random booth; then the drumroll and the trap.
coleccionista.panel.pue_terminar_ayuda: Ends the trial (closes the floors and opens the gates).
coleccionista.panel.pue_estado.lista: Ready: everyone in the lobby (round %s of %s)
coleccionista.panel.pue_estado.entre: Between rounds (round %s of %s): press Next round
coleccionista.panel.com_nota: New random pairs, face to face at a table. They talk for a minute, then each chooses in secret: SHARE or STEAL. The tables are revealed one by one on the giant screen and on everyone's screen.
coleccionista.panel.pue_nota: Each round the doors change color and the Collector gives a hint (sometimes he lies). Everyone gets into a booth; in one of them the floor opens. If everyone picks the trapped one, it doesn't open that time. Settings: /evento puertas rondas N and tiempo N.
coleccionista.cop.sin_mapa: The Final Chamber isn't built yet: use /evento construir.
coleccionista.cop.ya_empezo: The final is already running: end it before preparing it again.
coleccionista.cop.muchos: At most %2$s pieces may remain for the final (%1$s remain).
coleccionista.cop.fundido: At last… the final pieces of my collection.
coleccionista.cop.lema: Only one piece leaves this place
coleccionista.cop.chat.turno: Your turn, %s. Choose a cup and drink it.
coleccionista.cop.chat.elijo: Can't decide? I'll choose for you.
coleccionista.cop.chat.sirve: I'll pour again. Once again, one of them is poisoned.
coleccionista.cop.cmd.preparada: The final is ready: the last pieces to the Final Chamber.
coleccionista.cop.cmd.no_toca: That can't be done right now in the final.
coleccionista.cop.cmd.bebe: Whoever has the turn drinks (a random cup).
coleccionista.cop.hud.lista: The final · wait for the signal
coleccionista.voz.copas.hola: Welcome to my chamber. Few make it this far.
coleccionista.voz.copas.llegaron: You are the most valuable pieces in my collection.
coleccionista.voz.copas.copas: There are several cups on the table. They all smell the same.
coleccionista.voz.copas.turnos: Taking turns, each of you will drink one. The last piece standing… is free.
coleccionista.panel.cop_preparar_ayuda: Fade to black and the last pieces (2 to 4) to the Final Chamber table, with the cups poured.
coleccionista.panel.cop_empezar_ayuda: The Collector explains the final and the first turn begins.
coleccionista.panel.cop_ya_ayuda: Starts the first turn without the speech.
coleccionista.panel.cop_beber_ayuda: Whoever has the turn drinks a random cup (if they take too long).
coleccionista.panel.cop_terminar_ayuda: Ends the final and removes the cups.
coleccionista.panel.cop_estado.lista: Ready: everyone at the table, waiting for your signal
coleccionista.panel.cop_nota: The last 2 to 4 pieces around the table. There are two more cups than pieces and one is poisoned. Taking turns, each drinks one (right-click); if someone falls and several remain, the cups are poured again. The last piece wins.
